title: FundingSnapshot
description: One funding settlement for one perpetual. THIS SCHEMA IS A DIRECT CONTRACT FOR AN EXISTING TABLE: data.funding (instrument_id, venue_id, funding_time, rate, cap, predicted, source, retrieved_at) with PK (instrument_id, venue_id, funding_time) and a venue-scoped index. It is written down because the table's shape is currently undocumented as a contract, so nothing stops a second funding table appearing with a different key. rate is a RATIO per common/ratio.json (0-1, signed) - not a percentage: a 0.0001 funding rate is 0.01 percent, and storing the percentage in a ratio field is a 100x error. predicted distinguishes a settled rate from a venue's forecast, which is a different fact and must never be overwritten by it.

funding_time.description: The settlement instant, supplied by the venue. Part of the PK, matching data.funding.

rate.description: Signed ratio (0-1 scale). Positive means longs pay shorts.

predicted.description: True for the venue's forecast of the NEXT settlement, false for a settled one. A forecast must never overwrite a settlement.
